title: Penguin Craft | Winter Cut and Paste Activity | Fine Motor Scissor Skills
pdfName: Build-a-Winter-Penguin Craft Kit (Pre-K to 1st Grade) - TPT & Etsy.pdf
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: K.G.A.1 • K.G.A.2. For Pre-K, it builds toward these standards.

This Build-a-Winter-Penguin Craft Kit is a cut-and-paste activity for building scissor skills. Kids layer a white belly onto the penguin body, add 2 flippers, eyes, an orange beak and feet. It works well for winter bulletin boards, fine motor centers, OT and small groups.

✂️ Extra-thick cutting lines. Bold lines and simple shapes are easy for little hands to cut.

🎨 3 ways to prep:

⭐ Option A, Color & Cut: print on white paper. Students color, cut and glue.

⭐ Option B, Colored Paper: print on colored paper. No coloring needed!

⭐ Option C, Classroom Bulk: several pieces on each page to save paper and prep time for the whole class.

📦 What's included (14 pages):

✔ Teacher guide with a supplies list and a finished example

✔ Step-by-step student directions

✔ Option A templates (2 pages)

✔ Option B templates (3 pages)

✔ Option C classroom bulk templates (4 pages)

✔ Bonus "Chilly Winter Penguin!" coloring page

🧠 Skills practiced: scissor skills • fine motor • layering • coloring • following directions

💡 Teacher tip: Perfect for a polar animals unit; add googly eyes for extra giggles.
